loop engineering best practices.question: loop engineering best practices
loop engineering best practices.answer: A bounded agent loop needs runtime limits that the model cannot override. Claude Agent SDK configuration exposes max_turns and a task budget, so the host can set an execution ceiling independently of the model's own assessment.

loop engineering best practices common m.question: loop engineering best practices common mistake
loop engineering best practices common m.answer: A reliable loop needs observable checks rather than an untested declaration of success. Google SRE notes that a failing test demonstrates a reliability problem, and that a system-level test can block a push before the bug reaches production.

loop engineering best practices how to v.answer: The Model Context Protocol separates resources, prompts, and tools in the host-server boundary. Its specification also assigns the host responsibility for user consent and control over data access and operations.
